urlhaus.name: URLhaus (abuse.ch)
urlhaus.terms: abuse.ch publishes URLhaus data for commercial and non-commercial use without restriction (CC0). Re-check https://urlhaus.abuse.ch/api/ before each release.
urlhaus.use: Hostnames from web-injection campaigns (ClearFake, SocGholish/FakeUpdates, Balada, Keitaro, WordPress-tagged) become host signatures for files and database content. Payload-hosting entries (IoT botnets, loaders) are ignored: they do not appear in WordPress content.
urlhaus.reliability: high for listed URLs; host-level matching excludes shared platforms

malwarebazaar.name: MalwareBazaar (abuse.ch)
malwarebazaar.terms: Free API; requires an Auth-Key (free abuse.ch account) since 2025. Data CC0. Set ABUSECH_AUTH_KEY.
malwarebazaar.use: SHA-256 hashes of samples tagged php/webshell/wordpress become hash signatures (exact match, essentially no false positives).

signature-base.name: Neo23x0/signature-base (Florian Roth, Nextron Systems)
signature-base.terms: Detection Rule License 1.1: redistribution and modification allowed; the author, reference and license information supplied with each rule must be retained (kept in each signature's source/description).
signature-base.use: PHP web shell YARA rules whose strings are plain text and whose condition is any/all/N of them are converted to regex signatures. Hex strings, byte-offset conditions and wide strings are skipped.
signature-base.reliability: curated; every converted rule must match nothing in the clean corpus

community.name: Community submissions
community.terms: Submitted through pull requests; never applied without maintainer approval.
community.use: Signatures in the plugin's schema, run through the same validation and corpus tests.

wpscan.name: WPScan vulnerability database
wpscan.license: Commercial terms; free tier limited to non-commercial use
wpscan.terms: Not integrated: redistributing data in a free plugin used commercially would breach the free-tier terms.

imunify360.name: Imunify360 signatures
imunify360.terms: Never copied or redistributed. FCK Malware only imports the per-site detection results the local agent reports.
